media.prompt: A square flat-vector travel-app splash: a mountain lake at sunrise, red cabin, pines, jetty and yellow boat, no text, no letters, no logos
media.note: Clean, well-balanced flat design that follows every listed element, and no stray lettering. Faults: the reflections are wrong (a sun shows in the water though the sun is behind a peak, and the boat floats above its own jetty). ComfyUI's own template, 12 steps, with its optional Qwen3.8 27B prompt expander bypassed because that file is not on disk; the caption was written by hand. MIT (ComfyUI repackage).

what: Edit an existing image with Ming Image 0.1 Design, a 6B model tuned for UI, infographics, and posters. It takes one input image plus the boxes you draw on it — position, description, and colour palette — and rebuilds them into a layer-by-layer caption, returning one re-rendered image. Ideal for restaging a layout, poster-style re-renders, and turning a photograph into a designed composition.
